semantics.authority: Native owns stdin/stdout directly. Enable only the exact local profile with verified sidecar instance nonce and PPID, first hello binds current Native process epoch/owner/tenant. Market mode logs only safe diagnostics to stderr. HTTP bearer is machine access, Trace is correlation only. Neither can register grants or decisions.
semantics.registration: Native validates current lease and normal chat/connector permissions under its authorization lock, freezes original SQL31 intent, resolves existing attachment inputs and compares current service installation revisions/generations before grant_register. Full immutable body travels only through this owned pipe; grants carry no platform secret and no free URL/env/command.
semantics.idempotency: Mutation operation IDs compare full typed intent, not only selection digest. Host durable full-intent HMAC excludes transport requestId/grantRef and renewed authority expiry/revision. Original accepted operation is returned before prepare/config/Runtime work. Pending/uncertain require original fact recovery, never a replacement operation or automatic repeated external call.
semantics.lifetime: Grant deadlines are min(trusted Native expiry remaining,300000ms), converted once to monotonic time. Repeat registration never renews a grant. Expired/revoked grant cannot execute; reauthorization requires a new grant referring to the same frozen intent and never revives a used lease. Bounded ephemeral full payloads are released after consume/expiry/revoke; retain only bounded safe receipt/identity as needed for replay.
semantics.submit: Only the trusted grant payload is executed. For new sessions use task mapping owned by this family and reject legacy collisions; initial expectedModelRevision0 precedes initial Host revision1. Under one existing model-operation lock: accepted receipt comparison first, prepare immutable selection, combine model/selection into one thread/start or idle/cold-resume, start actual turn, bind actual thread+turn. Empty selection removes every market tool and cannot inherit previous/global MCP.
semantics.revocation: Native permission or installation changes invalidate matching grants and capabilities through revoke_authority; reducing-authority actions must still work after expiry. EOF retires all grants and market capabilities before normal Host/Runtime cleanup. Preserve STOP_PENDING ownership; never force-kill, respawn or claim external rollback.
semantics.approvals: Only actual Gateway metadata locates a trusted Broker call. Host approval authority uses exact current thread/turn/call/revision/args and safe review projection; private Native approval_decide is the user authority. Nonempty market selection supports only ask in this candidate; auto/full fails permission_mode_unavailable and directs the user to request approval mode. Empty selection retains all existing permission modes. Old Sorftime schemas/decisions cannot approve market calls.
semantics.observations: Read routes never grant execution. Scope follows the pipe-bound local identity and stored market task/session ownership, not caller trace. Tool facts come from native items, approvals from actual pending calls. Optional linkage requires explicit trustworthy evidence; no matching by latest item/tool/arguments. Every GET requires canonical non-nil X-Yijie-Market-Request-Id and echoes it; correlation only, never grant authority. When no current Host exists Native returns scoped durable managed/selectionDisplay and omits unqueried remote facts without starting/probing a Host. With a current owned Host, known historical tool items may be read after matching owner/tenant, agent session, native thread and native turn even if the stored turn belongs to an older Host generation. Such reads never restore grants, capabilities or approval callbacks. Approval validation and decisions still require the current Host generation and exact current call. Current Host read failures remain typed errors. Recheck local view and task.read after asynchronous reads. Historical observations do not block a new explicitly authorized turn using fresh enabled refs and admission. ToolSnapshot.truncated indicates omitted result information, not merely an additional structuredContent copy. A complete text block that contains the identical JSON value in the same member order (ignoring JSON whitespace) already represents that structured copy; differing or omitted structured content remains truncated. Native optional availableTurns/turnsTruncated exposes at most 128 original bound turns in reverse submission order without a new database or Runtime history reconstruction. Explicit historical reads use that turn's submitted display, preserve current approval authority separately, and never auto-select/replay tools. Unmanaged local sessions return without accessing Host.
semantics.rollback: New family outboxes and Host task mappings stay isolated from legacy paths. Feature-off readers preserve records but never downgrade/dispatch them as legacy. Legacy Sorftime execution is retired by Owner decision; its history and approval shapes remain readable, but cannot execute or authorize market calls. The legacy permission-scope route returns inactive without restarting Runtime. Rollback must not restore the retired writer or infer grants from history.
